title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 6th Proof The Testimony Of The Purified Ones Scholars And Sages

questions.question: Who are the people described in this passage as giving strong support to the Prophet’s truthfulness?
questions.answer: Large numbers of sincere and careful scholars and faithful wise people who reached the highest level of learning through his teachings.

questions.question: What is striking about their learning in relation to the Prophet’s personal background?
questions.answer: They gained very high knowledge through the teachings of someone who himself was not formally taught in the usual way.

questions.question: Besides teaching sacred truths, what two other achievements are attributed to him in the passage?
questions.answer: He is presented as bringing forth lofty branches of knowledge and uncovering God-given understanding.

questions.question: What central belief do these scholars and sages strongly confirm?
questions.answer: They firmly confirm the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, how is that belief connected to the Prophet’s mission?
questions.answer: It is described as the basic foundation of his mission.

questions.question: In addition to affirming Divine unity, what else do they testify to?
questions.answer: They testify that he was truthful and that what he said was true.

questions.question: How united are they said to be in this testimony?
questions.answer: They are presented as being in full agreement.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the strength of the evidence they use?
questions.answer: It says they rely on the strongest proofs.

questions.question: What comparison is used to show how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: It is compared to something as obvious as daylight.

questions.question: How does the passage present the Risale-i Nur in relation to this evidence?
questions.answer: It presents the hundred-part Risale-i Nur as one proof among the proofs of his truthfulness.

questions.question: What kind of people are highlighted at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: Purified, sincere, precise scholars and trustworthy sages.

questions.question: How did these people reach the highest rank of learning?
questions.answer: They reached it through the teaching and training contained in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention that he was unlettered?
questions.answer: To show the remarkable nature of the knowledge and instruction connected to him.

questions.question: What kinds of knowledge are connected to him in the passage?
questions.answer: Elevated sciences and Divine forms of knowledge.

questions.question: What is the first major thing these scholars and sages prove together?
questions.answer: The oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What is the second major thing they bear witness to together?
questions.answer: The truthfulness of the Prophet as a supreme teacher and great guide, and the truth of his words.

questions.question: Does the passage treat their witness as weak opinion, personal admiration, or solid evidence?
questions.answer: Solid evidence.

questions.question: What wording shows the passage sees their agreement as especially strong?
questions.answer: It says they are unanimous and supported by the strongest proofs.

questions.question: What role does the Risale-i Nur play in the final sentence of the passage?
questions.answer: It is presented as a further proof of the Prophet’s truthfulness.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities mark the scholars and sages being discussed?
questions.answer: They are spiritually refined, honest, careful, faithful, and highly learned.

questions.question: What produced their growth into top-level scholars, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The teachings and instruction found in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What tension or contrast appears in the description of the Prophet?
questions.answer: Even though he was unlettered, he is linked with profound teaching, major sciences, and God-given knowledge.

questions.question: What does the passage say he brought or uncovered?
questions.answer: It says he introduced exalted sciences and discovered Divine knowledge.

questions.question: Which doctrine is called the foundation of his mission?
questions.answer: The unity of Allah.

questions.question: What does their witness say about his personal reliability?
questions.answer: It says he is truthful.

questions.question: What does their witness say about his speech or message?
questions.answer: It says his words are true.

questions.question: Why is their testimony presented as especially convincing?
questions.answer: Because many highly qualified people agree on it and support it with very strong evidence.

questions.question: In simple terms, what is the main point of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The highest-level scholars formed through his teachings collectively prove the truth of his message and the truthfulness of the one who brought it.

questions.question: What group does the passage use as witnesses in support of the Prophet?
questions.answer: Millions of devoted scholars and faithful wise people.

questions.question: Are these people described as careless followers or as disciplined thinkers?
questions.answer: They are described as disciplined, exact, and sincere thinkers.

questions.question: What source shaped their education?
questions.answer: The sacred truths and instruction brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: Why does the passage emphasize their reaching the highest level of learning?
questions.answer: To show that his teachings were strong enough to produce the most advanced intellectual and spiritual development.

questions.question: What unusual feature of the Prophet is mentioned alongside this achievement?
questions.answer: That he was unlettered.

questions.question: According to the passage, what did he contribute in the area of knowledge?
questions.answer: He brought lofty sciences and uncovered Divine knowledge.

questions.question: What is the passage’s first claim about what these scholars establish?
questions.answer: They establish the oneness of Allah.

questions.question: What further testimony do they give about the Prophet himself?
questions.answer: They testify that he is a supreme teacher, a great master, and a truthful messenger whose words are true.

questions.question: How clearly does the passage say this proof appears?
questions.answer: It says the proof is as clear as broad daylight.

questions.question: What does the mention of the hundred parts of Risale-i Nur add to the argument?
questions.answer: It adds that this work also serves as a proof supporting his truthfulness.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the moral and intellectual character of the scholars it mentions?
questions.answer: They are morally sincere and careful, and intellectually advanced and trustworthy.

questions.question: Through what means did they gain their high learning?
questions.answer: Through the lessons and guidance contained in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: What two areas of knowledge are especially connected to him?
questions.answer: Higher sciences and knowledge given by Allah.

questions.question: What shared conclusion do these scholars reach about Allah?
questions.answer: They agree on Allah’s absolute oneness.

questions.question: Why is that conclusion especially important in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it is described as the core basis of the Prophet’s mission.

questions.question: What shared conclusion do they reach about the Prophet?
questions.answer: They agree that he is truthful and that his message is true.

questions.question: What phrase in the passage shows that their conclusion is not random or isolated?
questions.answer: Their agreement is described as unanimous and backed by the strongest proofs.

questions.question: What image is used to communicate the obviousness of this proof?
questions.answer: The image of daylight.

questions.question: How is the Risale-i Nur positioned at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: As one clear supporting proof among the evidences for his truthfulness.

questions.question: What makes these scholars and sages important witnesses?
questions.answer: They are numerous, sincere, careful, faithful, and have reached the highest level of learning.

questions.question: What formed them into such accomplished people?
questions.answer: The instruction and teaching found in the sacred truths brought by the Prophet.

questions.question: How does the passage use the fact that the Prophet was unlettered?
questions.answer: It uses it to highlight how extraordinary it is that such deep knowledge and teaching came through him.

questions.question: What does the passage say he developed or uncovered in the realm of knowledge?
questions.answer: Exalted sciences and Divine knowledge.

questions.question: What belief do these learned people confirm first?
questions.answer: The belief that Allah is One.

questions.question: What do they also confirm about the Prophet’s role?
questions.answer: That he is a supreme teacher and great master whose truthfulness is certain.

questions.question: What do they say about the content of his speech?
questions.answer: They affirm that his words are true.

questions.question: What does the passage imply by saying their proof is like daylight?
questions.answer: It implies that the evidence is open, strong, and hard to deny.

questions.question: What final supporting example is named in the passage?
questions.answer: The hundred-part Risale-i Nur as a proof of his truthfulness.
